methods.label: Locate using a decimal approximation
methods.explanation: \(\pi\approx3.14159\), so it lies between \(3\) and \(4\), approximately \(0.14\) to the right of \(3\).
methods.levelReason: Uses a familiar approximation of π to locate a real number on the number line.

candidate.annotationRationale: Locating a real number on the number line matches cnm_078. The known approximate value of π is supporting knowledge from cnm_p189. No geometry or construction is used or needed. candidate.changeReason: The approximation correctly places π between 3 and 4 about 0.14 beyond 3, establishing C with sufficient detail.
